resolution_notes: base_url: KEEP ORIGINAL. AP's current Swagger declares host api.ap.org and basePath /media/v; Search documents https://api.ap.org/media/v[{version}]/content/search and says version is optional. https://api.ap.org/media/v/swagger/ ; https://api.ap.org/media/v/docs/Search.htm example: CORRECTED RESPONSE SHAPE. The official Search page confirms /media/v/content/search, q, page_size, and x-api-key, while its sample places type and other content metadata inside item, not beside item. https://api.ap.org/media/v/docs/Search.htm
